# P4A adversarial review (read-only)

**Verdict: not approved** — two actionable **P2** findings against packet gates and dev/config scope. No **P0** or **P1** defects found in schema, honesty boundaries, seven-mode catalog, hint/reveal grading, or audio-match non-emission.

---

## What passes (no actionable issue)

| Area | Assessment |
|------|------------|
| **Seven modes** | `PRACTICE_GAME_IDS` is exhaustive (7), runtime `assertExactPracticeGameIds` / diff helpers; catalog + SSG `generateStaticParams` align; no catch-all under `app/practice/`. |
| **Events / parser** | Emissions go through `parseLearnerEvent` (`game-events.ts`); families/dimensions match `TASK_FAMILY_DIMENSION` (e.g. `pictureRecognition`→`recognition`, `sentenceOrder`→`form`, `flashcard`→`selfRatedAttempt` only). |
| **Hint / reveal** | `gradeObjectiveAttempt` never returns `correct` when `revealed \|\| hintsUsed > 0`; tests assert `partial` on emit. |
| **Audio-match** | Unavailable copy only; `emitAudioMatchAttempt()` returns `emitted: false`; UI has no Submit; no graded `onEvent`. |
| **German / leaks** | Prompts from `detail-canonical-contract` only; tests scan for plurals/audio/review markers. |
| **Mastery / persistence** | No `localStorage`/reducer; in-session array + honest “not persisted yet” copy. |
| **Routes / 404** | `resolveLearnerRoute` fail-closed for unknown/extra/malformed practice; smoke script covers practice 200/404; proxy matcher includes `/practice`. |
| **Production build** | `build`: `next build --webpack` + `extensionAlias` / learning alias in `next.config.ts` matches worker report. |
| **Unit tests** | `p4a-games.test.ts` covers IDs, prompts, grading, `parseLearnerEvent`, routes, hint/reveal, audio non-emit. |

---

## Findings (actionable P0–P2)

### P2 — Dev vs production module resolution (practice broken in default dev)

| Field | Value |
|-------|--------|
| **Severity** | P2 |
| **File** | `platform/apps/web/package.json` |
| **Line** | 9 |
| **Issue** | `"dev": "npm run project && next dev"` uses default Turbopack dev, while P4A pulls `@german-learning/learning` into the client graph and production relies on **webpack** `extensionAlias` + alias (`next.config.ts` lines 16–41). Worker report admits Turbopack may not resolve TS ESM `.js`→`.ts`; gates do not exercise `dev`. |
| **Fix** | Align dev with production resolver: e.g. `next dev --webpack` on Next 16.3 if supported, or add equivalent Turbopack `resolveAlias` / `transpilePackages` when available; document if dev is intentionally unsupported. |

---

### P2 — Packet behavioral UI gate not met (submit / retry / feedback)

| Field | Value |
|-------|--------|
| **Severity** | P2 |
| **File** | `platform/tests/web/p4a-games-ui.test.ts` |
| **Line** | 91–201 (entire behavioral surface) |
| **Issue** | Packet requires *behavioral* SSR/client tests for **selection, submit, retry, keyboard semantics and feedback** (`P4A-seven-games.md` lines 65–66). Tests only use `renderToStaticMarkup` and string assertions (e.g. presence of “Submit”, “Retry”, `type="button"`). They do **not** invoke submit/retry/reveal handlers, assert `GameFeedback` after actions, or verify `onEvent` / non-emit paths from components. Emit/hint logic is covered in `p4a-games.test.ts`, but not as **component behavioral** tests as specified. |
| **Fix** | Add tests that call game submit/retry/reveal (e.g. extracted handlers or `@testing-library/react` with client render), assert feedback `kind`/messages and `onEvent` emission (or explicit non-emit for empty/audio). |

---

## Non-blocking notes (P3 / hygiene)

| Severity | File | Line | Note |
|----------|------|------|------|
| P3 | `platform/apps/web/components/games/AudioMatchGame.tsx` | 22–23 | `emitAudioMatchAttempt()` runs on every render (impure; Strict Mode double-call). Prefer static unavailable copy only; emit is already unit-tested. |
| P3 | `platform/apps/web/lib/games/game-types.ts` | 84 | `EmitResult.reason: "unsafe-input"` never returned; `emitObjectiveGameAttempt` still emits `objectiveAttempt` with `incorrect` for unsafe input (allowed by packet wording). |
| P3 | `platform/apps/web/lib/content/routes.ts` | 515–523 | `listCanonicalPracticeRoutePaths` duplicates the seven IDs instead of importing `PRACTICE_GAME_IDS` (drift risk only). |
| P3 | `platform/apps/web/components/games/GameRenderer.tsx` | 48–68 | Seven `if` branches vs centralized ID list — no compile-time exhaustiveness tie to `PRACTICE_GAME_IDS` (mitigated by UI tests per mode). |

---

## Prior gates

Cannot execute `npm run check` in this review. P3A–P3D test files remain present; P4A adds parallel unit/UI tests without obvious removal of prior route/search/detail assertions. **No read-only evidence of prior-gate regression**; runtime green is worker-claimed only.

---

## Summary

Core P4A contracts (seven modes, `parseLearnerEvent`, hint/reveal, audio honesty, canonical routes, no fake mastery) are implemented consistently with the packet and learning `events.ts` policy. **Approval is withheld** until **P2** dev/build parity for local practice and **P2** behavioral component tests for submit/retry/feedback are addressed.
